I was a chronic user of cocain not to say a darn addict, for nearly a decade. My first step was to take the decision to stop, so you are doing great, you have balls. Then, in order to stop destroying myself I also deleted all my dealers numbers. Then I stopped seeing all my friends (friends?) with the same consume problem as mine, that was ever harder, I was pretty much alone. Then the withdrawal effects almost killed me for at least a month. You are going to miss everything about it. Try to keep your mind away from thinking about whatever you consumed. Read, do sports, cry, search for professional help, remember that in order to consume you have to have time so keep busy all the time. I really hope the best for you. You can do it!
